text: Great little place.  I had the BLT on sourdough bread,  my dad had the burger with fries.  Both were delicious.  Our server was super nice an was always there ready to fill up my ice tea.  Definitely recommend this place.

This is truly a bakery where you can get freshly baked bread and other goodies. I have been following them since they had their bread for sale when sharing a tent with another vendor at the Temple Terrace Farmers Market.  Our favorite is the sourdough baguette and cinnamon bun.  They also sell breakfast sandwiches.  The only reason I gave them 4 stars is that they slice all their loaf bread and we like to slice our own.
First stop on our Walk & Rat Nashville Food Tour!!! Fabulous fluffy and buttery biscuits, local made jams!!! Just delish!!

Really enjoyed our first visit to Seedz for lunch on Saturday. We shared the Malibu Melt which was good and the Veggie Pizza which was delicious! I can't wait to go back. We recently started a plant based diet and we will definitely become regulars. The place is pretty small and very busy at lunchtime so seating may be limited.

Vibes: modern, casual ramen joint with mostly hightop bench and window counter seating and a nod to Japan with themed art 

Tasting notes:
-Takoyaki: served piping hot with generous topping of bonito flakes and a strip of sweet mayo; crispy, tender exterior with creamy interior that is filled with multiple pieces of chewy octopus
-Shoyu: broth is not too salty or oily, offers predominantly bone flavor rather than of soy sauce; ramen noodles are wavy with a tender bite; chashu pork is delicate from its fattiness; love the marinated egg with its sweet jammy center 

Other thoughts:
-Got seated as a party of four right away on a rainy Friday evening
-Staff is friendly and attentive
-Service is fairly fast

We sat at the bar and loved the ambiance of this adorable place. The service was great. The Rincon margarita was amazing. We had the crab cakes, salmon tacos and wild salmon plank dinner which were all delicious
Best restaurant I've while in Tucson! The service was professional.  The food was amazing. Worth the price. The drinks where amazing too!

We want in around 5p and it took about 10 min to get seated.   It took another 20min to get someone to take our drink /order.  

We sat a bit longer waiting for our drinks. (cokes ,Nothing fancy).  

Now, we can see our food sitting under the heat lamps but we're powerless to get it ourselves.  

Eventually, a different server dropped off our food and said our waitress would be by soon to check on us.   While the food was hot, my toppings were slightly off from what I ordered.  

We had to search out an open store to use gift cards.  I LOVE steak n shake but you get why the are almost totally extinct in most parts of town..

Fantastic chowder!  Great service and atmosphere 
Marvelous lunch with view of the ocean! 
We've visited the same name restaurant in Santa Monica. This Santa Barbara restaurant is far better!
Do not miss it!!
Slowest service ever. Sesame wings were trashy tasting. My order of rice was forgotten altogether. Definitely will not give it another try.
I have only gone here once, but their danishes haunt my dreams. I recommend getting your doughy needs here.

Horrible!
Terrible sushi, old ingredients, absolutely a rip off!
Went their at 2:45 and ordered 
Got the bill and was changed the dinner price
Hostess never said a word that it was now dinner menu
Music in the background was Michael Jackson!
Sushi chef did not use food gloves
Waitress did not wear gloves
None of the staff were Asian!
A waste of time and money!
Better off getting some sushi from Whole Foods
This place won't last as they are clueless 
Ordered hot tea and it was cold
When we asked if it could be heated she said the microwave was used for the unagi and they could not warm up the cold tea!
It was a nightmare!
Stay away!!

Pretty good Italian place. Nice size portions for the price! Will definitely return. The server didn't ask if we wanted more bread, so not sure if you only get one basket? The lasagna I had could have been warmer, but it was still good.
This place hands down has the best sushi in Mt. Juliet!  The servers are friendly and they really care about the food.   The Heart Attack roll is amazing!!
10/10! One of the places I always have to visit when I come back to Nashville bc nowhere else can get it quite right!
Omg. Best sandwiches ever! And it's such a cute place. The hours are very limited tho. Def recommend!

Came here for a work dinner and will definitely be returning. There is plenty of seating inside and a bar as well if you're looking for some drinks. The food was really good, your typical Irish fare, and really isn't too expensive either. The drink prices are very fair as well and the bar tenders were quite friendly. Even though we weren't the only large party the night we dined here our service was exceptional and the waitress was very attentive, regularly checking if we needed refills and the like. If you're looking for a good pub with good Irish food I'd certainly recommend coming to O'Reilly's!

I hadn't been to this place in years and I'm so mad at myself for waiting so long to come back. I love bars where you can actually have a conversation with your bartender and they make you their favorite drinks. Both bartenders were amazing and the pizza was the pretty amazing too!

We went to juniper during covid and had a great time! The chicken sandwich was amazing (I got the hot level though & expected it to be hotter). The cocktails were great as well. Tables were adequately spaced out and would recommend.

Tourists beware. I've been twice and had 2 very different experiences. The first time was great. Strong drinks, nice bartender, etc. The 2nd time wasn't so good. The bartender gave me my check for 2 drinks and it was over $50.. when I questioned him about it, he was rude and told me he must have put the wrong rum on there. No apology whatsoever.. I think this was a ploy to screw over tourists and for them to make a little extra money. I'm local and had been there before, so I knew better. Always watch your receipts and charges!
Good bagels, wraps, sandwiches, soups, and bread. Wide variety of bagel and soup offerings too, unlike any other place around. Some vegetarian friendly options too, and vegan with adjustments!

Truly a lovely, fun and delish experience. I was in Tampa for the PRSA Sun Con event held at the Hilton Downtown Tampa. After a long travel day we were looking for a local place that was cool and we found it directly across the street from the Hilton. The drinks were excellent as was the food. Our waiter was top-notch. This place has a cool, hip vibe. Top notch.

We have loved Ling & Louie's for a long time. Today for Happy Hour they have added more TV's and have some fun music videos playing of all genre's of music.  Tables are spaced. Employees are wearing masks. Great place to be!!

Have not been to this location in a while.  Previously, I had given them 5 stars, but tonight nothing was as it had been.  It was busy, but you would expect that on a Saturday.  Everything we ordered was overcooked.  Didn't seem like they had enough servers.  One of the first items we ordered never arrived and then when we asked about it, (Coconut Shrimp) it looked like it had been left in the fryer.  Maybe new management, maybe  new cooks, but definitely not at all the same standard as several month's ago.
This place is great. I wish their food portions were a little bit bigger but they are still really good. Worth your time and money.

After walking down the Avenue and reading various menus CK's seemed to make my crew of six happy.
Hoping to please the kids and the grown-up kids we found our table with the perfect view of fresh pizza being prepared. My family manage to order burgers, fresh pizza, grouper sandwich, buffalo chicken and a steak sandwich. Absolutely everything was delicious! Even my pickiest eaters were very happy. I highly recommend this restaurant, for family, and a wonderful drink with your friends.

I've had great sandwiches here before. Always the hook and Ladder. Always delicious. Yesterday, first time I used the drive thru order pick up. Sandwich was still piping hot and staff pleasant. problem was the veggies.  There was old lettuce in it and the tomato and onion had no taste nor scent. The lettuce is what destroyed the sandwich, because even after taking the wilted stuff out the whole sandwich, it was left with that gross aftertaste of old lettuce. That rancidness. The meat was beautiful, full of flavor and aromatic. the cheese I couldn't find. My previous hook and Ladders were made with delicious aromatic bread. The bread yesterday was edible,  but I am not sure it was any better than store bought off the shelf with a fast approaching shelf life.  I know the quality the company prides itself on and for an $8.00 sandwich with no drink and no chips I think it's important to share this.

EDIT TO REPLY TO OWNDER:
I got a call saying the extra mayo/pate on the sandwich and extra gravy on the the Loco Moco is a $1 upcharge for each. Which I then said because I thought I was already charged & I checked out on Uber Eats, "Make it however you make it." Basucally, exclude my extras. Essentially,  show me what you're working with then.

I tasted the carrots and daikon before I took a bite of the whole sandwich. It WAS NOT  pickled.

You are mediocre at best.  Your response to me is completely unprofessional.

Take your review as it is. Don't make yourself look worse by arguing with an unsatisfied customer. Say you're sorry for my experience and you'll work on improving yourself. Don't argue. 

Good day, SIR.

-----------------

I would like to start by saying... Man, what a waste of 30 bucks. I am Vietnamese born and raised in Hawaii - food mecca, diversity galore. I know food.

I am visiting NOLA from Colorado and was chilling in my room all day when I decided to Uber me some food. The delivery was great,  no delays, nice lady,  and came sooner than expected. The food however was below par and I am disappointed in my experience. Especially since I read the reviews before ordering.  It seemed promising. 

I ordered a BMB Combo Banh Mi. It had a lot of meat but none of the homemade rich mayo that usually accompanies it. So it made the sandwich dry. On top of that,  there weren't any pickled carrots or daikon. Seriously?  That's one of the things that makes Viet banh m

I find this a good place to get decent Chinese takeout. I've picked up food from here about 4 times and I like most of the standard fare dishes; chow mein, egg rolls, fried rice, lemon chicken all taste good for the fried, unhealthy items that they may be. Eat at home in front of the tv with a pair of plastic chop sticks and enjoy this little guilty pleasure. 
We tried the dim sum platter last time and was decent with the steam buns being my favorite. They are soft and chewy with a nice pork filling. 
The restaurant is self is just a bland room with basic tables and no frills, but there is two big screen TVs if you feel like stopping in for lunch or dinner and catching a sports game. Service was fairly quick and to the point. Like I said, no frills, decent priced, Chinese takeout.

Dinner with friends on January 25, 2020; first timers. This is the loudest room I have ever been in and made for difficult conversation in our booth right next to the bar. Ordered all the antipasti and all were excellent. That was actually enough food for the four of us. However, we ordered entrees including the veal with capers; the beef lasagna; meatballs; and the tortellini. The latter was served in a large bowl of broth, which was a surprise and detracted from the taste of the pasta. It reminds one of wonton soup. The lasagnetta was served flat on a plate, the thickness of a pancake, although the serving size was adequate. The sausage provola was served in a compartmented metal plate usually seen filled with escargot. It was inedible due to its high temperature and the amount of salt. The service was good and all dishes and beverages were delivered on time. Spend was less than $400 for our foursome, which was reasonable. Our server had a large nose ring, among other piercings--a turn off for me. We will not return.

We returned to Felix's on the lakefront for lunch yesterday.  We appreciated Britney helping us to have such an enjoyable meal!  We all got the oyster po-boys with sweet potato fries.  Wish that I could have more today!

Probably the worst place to get a torta, I ordered a carnitas torta that was unfortunately lacking flavor and was less than lukewarm. I dined in and next to me was the baked goods and in with all the pastry were flies, not just flying inside but all over the bakery items. I was just grossed out by this. I will never eat here again....

Little bit pricier, only came here for drinks. 

Very cool interior style, half is a cafe and the other half is a bar. Enjoyable atmosphere.

Sadly this was our final visit to Hinoki. It became our go to spot because its one of the few sushi places that offers a roll with beef. The service is so bad and the inconsistency of the same rolls from one to the next is just too frustrating to deal with. The chefs pay no attention to instructions written on the order sheets. For example, "no tuna, add shrimp" Instead we got a roll with no shrimp and they filled it with extra sauted spinach which gave the roll a slimy texture and for whatever reason a "fishy" taste.  Once those first order sheets are handed over, good luck getting anymore from the wait staff. If you are able to flag someone down you're made to feel like you're bothering them to bring you more. Why don't they just leave more sheets on the table when they pick up completed ones? Probably because they want to discourage you from ordering another round. Requests for extra sauce on the side are completely ignored. Some rolls don't come out at all. We've had to ask about rolls that were on our sheets that we never received. Forget asking for extra sauce on the side, you'll be completely ignored. In one ear, out the other.  We always have the situation where everyone at our table gets their rolls except 1 person in our party is left waiting forever with no food. By the time their food comes out, the rest of us are done. It kinda kills the mood and the fun of swapping different kinds of rolls around the table. We always have the one person waiting on their favorite

I finally got a hand on their bread! I just bought their cinnamon swirl, classic sourdough and Tampa sandwich bread. I really love the classic sourdough the best, it's delicious with my avocado toasted every morning. I wasn't a huge fan of the cinnamon swirl sourdough loaf. The next time I go there, I want to try their fly-bys and flavored loaves! I highly recommend them if you want local, great quality bread! Shop small!!
Ordered delivery. Got two big bags of chips (great!) and zero salsa or guacamole. Thanks, I guess?? Really, what is the point?

I have been a South Philly transplant living in West Philly for 10 years surrounded by "Greek pizza" & artisan "brick ovens", and hating it for years. If I wanted a real pizza, I would always have to order and then pick it up from South Philly. Until I finally realized tonight that there was one south philly pizzeria willing to delivery out by my way via Uber Eats honest to goodness pizza, and it was Not Just Pizza. I'll tell ya, the cheese pizza brought me back to my childhood of buying a single slice at the counter of the corner shop. And their inside outs are better than Florida Stlyes, trust me

Bravo you guys, especially for breaking out of the south philly shell to deliver to us guys out of that area

I like this place  but it's kinda weird when I'm in my mid 40s and getting  IDed. 

There's no refund policy whatsoever. So make sure  you're not going to get hit by a car, get sick, or is being treating in the ER. No exceptions. 

Oh, and beware during the summertime, we had to wait inside when it's summer hot. 

Well, i did turn out to be in the ER! I cannot predict what's ahead. If I knew, I would've used your insurance policy. Which isn't worth much anyways when someone cannot show up because of an ERsituation.

I used to come here all the time and would get classic diner food and was never disappointed. Staff used to be friendly and on point. Went in yesterday and staff was extremely rude, my corndog was still frozen in the center, and this one man waiter literally stood there and stared at me the entire time I was there. This place is not like it used to be, save yourself some time and just go to McDonald's for some hot food.
I can't believe that I've waited so long to write this review of a place that not only had delicious food but friendly truly helpful waitstaff.

Ate here with another family, we were split between two tables. The table that my family was back broke in half (it was granite and old, they said it happens occasionally which was totally fine). Some drinks and food fell off. The other family at the non-broke  table ordered dessert and they gave them free dessert even though our table broke. They gave us nothing. To top it off, we were charged for the alcoholic beverages that fell off our table and shattered when the granite countertop broke.

This was one of the earlier Raising Cane fast food restaurants on the west coast.  They did a good job at getting a following and creating enough momentum or demand for these as more restaurants have subsequently followed.  In the end, the chicken tenders were really prepared nicely with very good flavor, nice crispy breaded outside and a hot and juicy chicken inside.  The fries are very good and of course the sauce as well.

Best burgers and fries in the greater Tampa area. Chicken sandwich was amazing as well. Favorite place to drink craft beer and have a good time playing games and eating great food. Staff is always friendly

A cool concept but don't go toward the end of the night. We went at 7:45 on a Monday and Willie Mae's was closed for the night for no apparent reason and the taco place was out of guac and pork (2 of the four parts of the Venezuelan sampler). Two other restaurants close early too. The Vietnamese place had some good bites though. We wouldn't go back due to the availability of product/services. Super disappointing.

This is the best pizza in town!  Deep dish is AWESOME!
The workers are great!  Love their lunch special for $5
Very yummy sushi, and is efficient at making sure takeout orders are out quick and easy. Have to make sure to ask for any sauce that you want so they can't put it in your bag.

Just recently found out about this gem. Loved my cheesesteak. Another time I had an Italian hoagie. Pretty busy spot but they keep it moving. 

I'd go again.
Always excellent service. My husband and I frequent at least once or twice a month. They always remember our order and drink of choice.

I give these folks a solid 3.5. Exceptional.service and a tasty pie. In fairness, I could not access the menu as I got an error on their website when Yelp tried to route me.  We ordered a supreme no onions or bell peppers. We added extra cheese and pepperoni. The pizza toppings were pepperoni, hamburger, mushrooms and extra cheese.  Hamburger was spicy which was really good and the pizza was very good.  I have nothing but good things to say except not knowing what toppings were to be on a supreme as I expected some more veggies and possibly sausage. Otherwise, it hit the spot and fast! Thx!!

This place is amazing!! Best poké spot in town and the nicest staff! It's so clean and bright in the store and the food is absolutely delicious. I have 3 kinds of fish, 2 sauces (the ginger aioli is so good), and lots of toppings. Every bite tastes fresh and unique. This just became my new favorite lunch spot.

This place was really good. I like trying new sushi places where I travel. I come to Philly a lot and have been to 3 or 4 sushi places. This may be my favorite so far. The presentation, even just for me dining by myself and for 2 sushi rolls, was fantastic and artistic. They put a lot of effort into the quality of their food. I will be back.
One the best places I've eaten a gyro in Tampa.  The servings the give you is awesome!

Once again, service was terrible. Three of us ordered dumplings at the same time. One order right away came up, other two took ridiculously long. That's it, I'm done. You can only hear the excuses so many times before you realize that they just don't know how to run their food.
All of these service issues started when they added UberEats and it has not gotten better since.

STL chain for Italian food in a somewhat upscale setting. Has been around for more than 50 years. Have both table and bar seating.

Complimentary bread 

I came for lunch and got their chicken sandwich, the bread was fresh and delicious.

Everything here is very solid, nothing spectacular and nothing terrible. Pretty standard Italian spot in the 'burbs

I tried their Camarones Al Ajillo bowl with yellow rice, black beans and fries egg on top. The flavors were out of this world. I honestly I didn't know what to expect but I'm so happy I gave this place a shot. The portions were a good size to get full then have leftovers for later. I can't wait to return to try other dishes on their menu

Cool bar right by my friends house. It was our 2nd time here. The clams in Gaelic are my favorite! Prices are fair. Had the lovely Chelsea as our waitress. Super cute, friendly & quick! Will be back next week! I wish they delivered.
Awesome puertorrican food !!!!!    Best red beans. Like my grandma used to cook them. Great Service great staff !!!! Great music.  A corner of Puerto Rico in ST. Petersburg!!!!!

If I could give zero stars I would. Call placed for beef short ribs, because I know they are slow after I received the text to go pick it up I waited an additional ten mins. Hopped in the car and when I was five mins away a number repeatedly called me , I answered heard nothing called the number back , a girl sounded like she was sleep said did you place a order. I said yes , in my head she telling me the food was ready just as my text said.WRONG .. she was telling me that they didn't have any short ribs(blank stare) looked at my phone as if maybe I'm tripping. Confused I said well why did y'all send me a text she said oh the system just sends it, so I'm the time of social distancing I would have been standing in there waiting (not good). I guess she got tired of hearing my rant so she puts a gentlemen on the phone , management of something or another. He said oh they must not have paid attention to the ticket because we have so many orders. But we will issue you a refund. What he should have said is could we get you something else..but no he got tired of hearing my rant so just offering a refund was his easy way out. To make matters worse i told one of my girlfriends about what happened she said it happened to her before , so this is what y'all do huh Victoria's good to know.. if you hungry don't go here unless you like gambling ...maybe you will eat, maybe you won't ! I try to support black businesses but this right here is ridiculous, it's not a holiday or anything. I won'

The service was good. We had fish tacos that were really good for a grilled fish taco. We also had the fish and chips. It was a big filet and tasted great. The slaw was so-so. The sweet potato fries were also so-so. We also had the California rolls that were okay.  We had eel that was delicious. Finally we had the hickory burger that was average. We had the regular fries with that, and they were delicious. The spinach dip was delicious!

Oh my goodness!... This Caribbean and Creole eatery just opened in one of State Street's historic spots is such a nice surprise. They're still in their "soft opening," and we happened to peek in before dinner hours, but Harold welcomed us and said, "Come on in... I'll cook for you!" 

The lunch menu at Embermill strikes a great balance. Without being overwhelmingly extensive, there's a range of meat dishes, but also tasty vegan offerings and lots of gluten-free options. There's also a wide range of pricing... all very fair. There are a few simple dishes that I think would please the "finicky" and also more "adventuresome" choices. We shared the Jamaican Jerk Chicken with rice and plantains (so tender it seemed it must have cooked for hours), a strawberry, leek and goat cheese quesadilla, and a coconut lassi. Everything was beautiful, balanced in flavor, texture and spices and was out of this world good!... (and wasn't over-priced). 

You can tell Embermill is going for a welcoming, non-fussy vibe. Harold and the other folks we met there were warm and fun. The place retains historic charm and offers a refreshing atmosphere with big open windows, tastefully simple decor and a huge farmhouse table and pleasant patio seating (where you can bring your pooch, I believe). They're offering a coffee bar and breakfast in the mornings, too (haven't tried it), kombucha-on-tap (if you're into that), and smoothies. If you're all about the food and a friendly vibe, Chef Harold's got you cov

This place is cute and unexpectedly roomy. After a small front counter space it opens up and there is a neat little living room set up. Very quiet and good for working. The breakfast sandwich was good too and they had rose lattes so I couldn't pass up on that one.

Can't wait to go tomorrow for lunch and introduce to a friend who hasn't yet been.
5 *'s stars all the way!
Service and food just outstanding!
Everything fresh, delicious, nice portions, and always clean inside!
Can hardly wait for lunch tomorrow !!! Oh that's right, I already mentioned that :)

The food here is OK--the ingredients seem to be pretty high quality, but the flavors were not very imaginative. The atmosphere is really cool and the decore is very nice.

The biggest problem, in my opinion, is the service. Despite there being only one other patron in the restaurant when we arrived, we had to specifically ask to be sat at a table and the hostess sort of grumbled about having to push two tables together in the otherwise empty room. Further, even though there seemed to be 4-6 people working, the service was quite slow. After we had decided what to order we were passed by no less than 3 employees before someone finally came by to take our order. Finally, when it was time for us to pay, the waiter stood over our shoulder and watched us select the tip amount (options were 20, 25, and 30% or custom). Because the waiter was standing over us, it was pretty difficult to negotiate the tip amount.

Overall, I would say the lack of creativity coupled with the unpleasant service are probably enough to keep me from coming back.
This place is adorable!! Delicious food! Delicious coffee!! Only thing is the presentation is a little lack luster. But a great place to sit and chat over a delicious coffee

Visiting from Atlanta area and have had great food in other cuisines  but Friday its time for Mexican and my family here hadn't found a good place. Until now!!!!  Julio was great !!!   They have a full bar with my favorite tequila which in itself was impressive.  The guacamole was awesome as were the entrees we each had.  The Volcano entree was ABSOLUTELY impressive and could have fed three !   I will definitely put Hacienda on MY weekly Friday night must go places !!!!
I was about to place my order but I was told they were only serving door dash and some other food delivery service they said they were to behind to take any more customers ‍‍‍
In January 2020 ECSS had a fire and has been closed since due to health code violations and the damage from the fire. That was in the local paper. Hopefully, they will reopen.
Good food, but doesnt seem that authentic. Ordered a dish with beef, thinking beef slices... but it was minced/ground beef. Still good for the price though and will still come back

We stayed at the RV park for a couple nights in early October while we visited the Reno area.  Very clean and nice park.  Staff was attentive and provided excellent service.  The RV spot we got was on an end and so we had a nice view and it had a very flat space so no having to deal with blocks for our trailer.  Would definitely recommend.

i've enjoyed this hip & healthy eatery ever since i arrived in "the Brooklyn of Florida" aka Saint Petersburg, but it's not until this very moment that i felt compelled to share what a great place it is.
As I stood in the socially distant queue, I noticed the chap before me wearing an awesome pair of Air Jordans and we had a very brief chat about sneakers while he paid and then he was off...
When it became time for ME to settle up, the young woman (Mari) at the register informed me "you're all good" (apparently she heard me reference the manager who shares the sneaker obsession and often comes out to see what i'm wearing while i dine )
Now THAT is customer service & appreciation and hopefully she'll be awarded for such by Grant & company.

Hands down, Felix's was my favorite meal in NOLA *heart-eyes emoji* My boyfriend and I came here for lunch on our last day in the city, and we were blown away by the quality of the food! I had the blackened shrimp with seasonal veggies and fries. My boyfriend had the fish of the day (a red fish) with crawfish etouffee on top (as recommended by our server). His entree also came with rice and seasonal veggies. Both dishes were flavorful and very well prepared - highly recommend both! We also split half a dozen of chargrilled oysters. They weren't as flavorful as we had hoped, but they were still good.

In sum, Felix is definitely a MUST-TRY in my book :)

Everything about Luv Child is what every restaurant should strive to be- crazy good menu, dog friendly outdoor dining and a fun atmosphere.

The menu drew me in. They have a ton of plant based options that isnt salad or tots. The plant based taco platter is nothing I have seen before and even if you aren't vegetarian or vegan, it is amazing bc of the variety offered - chickpeas, mushroom AND impossible sausage! Gah! All three are seasoned to perfection. It is the dish to get

We also ordered brussel sprouts and while they were delicious- I could have eaten a bucket of them and what veggie does anyone say that about! - they were a little too greasy.

The vibe is super fun. Definitely a place to go with friends or if youre a childless couple. Families with young kids would feel way out of place here. The vibe inside is totally miami... well, its trying to be!

A great menu...food and drink!  The service was second to none.  Our server was so helpful, friendly and attentive, on a busy night. What a great first impression of Boise.  Don't miss Bardenay's...the Mediterranean appetizer with house made hummus...the Bardenay dip--amazing!

I only had A couple of appetizers, and they were fantastic. They seemed really well priced at about $5 each. The restaurant is self had a great feel to it and our server was friendly and always there to help. 

I had the goat cheese and garlic spread and the meatball sliders. No picture for that, sorry I was busy eat
I'm excited to bring my wife back here for dinner.

Update: 6-8-19
I brought my wife here. 5 stars as usual. I had the same, she lamb, sorry I forgot to take a picture of it. She said it was fantastic. We will be back.

Came here to have a little silly fun.I wanted to eat first.First we attempted to sit down stairs to eat but that was a mistake no one ever came over to our table even after  asking the bartender and being told she send someone over.Since it was loud and busy we figured it might be better to go up stairs and eat as it is quieter and more for the adults.Well after being seated someone  walked by and said I'll be right with you.Now I know I'm at Dave and busters I  didn't have high hopes but I figure I'm not ordering anything so complicated.I order an Asian salad after looking over the menu as I do have some food restrictions. This salad had no cheese ginger dressing and chicken I remember after reading the description.When I ordered I confirmed that it had grilled chicken.The waiter agreed.So our wait was a little long but ok.My salad came out which appeared as a Caesar with chicken.I don't eat cheese there was cheese on it,creamy dressing with a big thing that looked like a chip.It was more cheese-a cheese chip thing.When I told the waiter he was polite but was dumb founded All he could say was you said grilled chicken.He totally did not hear me say Asian salad with grilled chicken!Ok so I didn't want to wait longer I said I'd eat it as I was very hungry and didn't want to make a fuss.But he didn't really offer to correct it he just looked confused.The lettuce was soft and the salad was not good at all.Best part was when the bill came it said Kale salad! There wasn't any kale,

This restaurant goes above and beyond for quality ingredients and you can taste it.  Everything I have had from the Frips, Grouper , Ruben and Cuban sandwiches to the burgers and pizzas you can't make a bad choice.
Great food. I'm from a town with no vegan restaurants so having such good food feels rare to me. Bartender was super chill, atmosphere relaxed. Great place to eat

Let me just start out in my first sentence stating that the owner is the biggest piece of sh*t I've ever encountered in the service industry. Literally verbally assaulted by him. Here's how my experience went down. My partner and i went for a hike and decided to end it with quick take out hoagies from Bruno's (I've been here once or twice before and never encountered this asshole in those previous times). we walk in. The cook/manager 50ish year old guy (the POS i referenced in my first sentence) seems busy, so we patiently wait till he addresses us for our orders. He comes up to us eventually and hastily barks at us "so you guys ready to order OR WHAT". Taken aback by his hasty and utter rudeness, my partner quickly states that he will take the Bella sandwich and then i say "can i have the tuna hoagie- junior size " - this bastard then gnarls his face , rolls his eyes and barks at us again "CAN you? What am i gonna say, NO??? Of COURSE you can." But in a nasty way. Not a trying to be funny way. Like he was genuinely pissed that we came in to purchase food. He then proceeds to ask if i want peppers on my hoagie and i say no. Shocked by his offensive behavior and embarrassed in front of the other patrons, we wait as our food is prepared without gloves, touching and handling cash, and then back to food prep
Atmosphere was gorgeous.  Vibe was killer.  But each plate was not only incredibly small for the price, but seemed disconnected.  Octapus was great though.

I don't like giving 1 star reviews, but MAN......
This place is bad......

Like....bad as in...you want to step behind the grill and cook your own food bad......

I can't believe this place is always packed, and I can't believe they serve this food.....

I still tipped my server 20% because it's not their fault that the food sucks, and she was working very hard, but MAN.....

The food here is bad......

Which makes me question how this place is open, but Tokyo Hibachi Grill Buffet right down the street closed down, when they had MUCH MUCH MUCH better food....

And it makes me question the taste buds of the clientele in this area.....

For this post, there are no pictures, because it was a waste of my cell phone memory............

20 minute wait for takeout in an empty restaurant and watching the staff dilly dally was super frustrating

But their failure to keep masks on and wash hands between mask touching and food handling was inexcusable.  Cashier was not even wearing a mask at all, even as a chin diaper. 

I didn't want to make a scene, but I threw away the food after leaving 

This place needs to shut down for training. 

And yes after a decade consuming Yelp, this experience was so appalling in the pandemic that I made an account to post this

It was a brisk September afternoon, I left work early that day to run some errands and found myself with some time to spare. Just peeking out the corner of my eye was the Cheesecake Factory. I figured let me stop in and grab a cheesecake slice for my beautiful wife to brighten her day a little. As I walked in I heard Jack Daniels calling my name so went straight to the bar, and ending up hanging out there for a while. Although I was having a drink alone, I was not sharing a drink called loneliness (Billy Joel reference). The atmosphere surely made me feel like I was somewhere else, and the staff all greeted me as they passed by as of I was just welcomed into their neighborhood. After finishing my drink, I parted ways and headed back to my car. As I was driving away and knowing it takes 25 minutes to make a u-turn in Jersey I completely forgot about the cheesecake....FML.

Was there Friday night had the best dinner. Hog fish was dynamite.  Great service even better food. Had lunch again on Monday Jesse was our waiter he was attentive and on top of his game. Once again food was terrific.  Love love we will be back very soon.

aesthetic: 6/5 

food: 5/5 

service: 5/5 

modern times simply just WOWS. first of all, i am in LOVE with modern times's urban-meets-minimalist aesthetic. think big leafy plants, cute LED signs and parking lot murals, round marble tables, and a comfy patio lounge with string lights hanging above. 

my friend and i each ordered the double double vegan burger. the coconut cheese and bun melted in my mouth, and the "meat" did not leave an overly-artificial meaty flavor in my mouth. the fries ($3) were perfectly crispy, and the serving was enough for me and my friend to finish. 

we also ordered the grapefruit bubble party. however, i was slightly disappointed by the drink because it was literally just grapefruit sparkling water.

all in all, modern times is probably the BEST spot to eat at if you are looking for a hip and friendly restaurant that serves affordable, delicious food in santa barbara. even if you're a dedicated meat-eater, i highly encourage you to give modern times kitchen's vegan dishes a try.
maybe you'll become addicted to this place like i am!! after all, who can't say no to a well-priced and yum lunch date while chilling on an adorable, tropical vibe patio?

Been traveling from NY to this place for over 10 years. This is by far the best Philly cheese steak I've ever had. It's definitely worth the tolls and gas. I would advise you to get the full size since you can eat it all week. It taste great the next day. Sorry I didn't write a review years ago.
The Baklava could be the best I've ever had. Not too sweet and perfectly flaky.  I got a falafel wrap with it that was excellent. I highly recommend the Damas.

This place was one of my favorites for the local area for Chinese buffet and sushi selections believe it or not. This last visit was not as expected. It was a busy Sunday afternoon so I would expect it to be great as usual but the food just wasn't up to par. Which is sad frankly given how much we have liked it here before. The sweet tea was also just "off". But at least you have your garden variety of circus sideshow to watch the people that walk into the door... Some should NOT be at the buffet, just saying...geez
Update: the owner reached out toe soon after this review profusely apologizing and then gave us a gift card. We are thankful for such kind remediation. We'll be back

You have to go! It's a great little spot with amazing food. The eggs Benedict and French toast are to die for. The really friendly and prompt service we received from Jenny was refreshing. She made us feel welcomed and we will definitely be back again.

The staff was lackadaisical and indifferent. The food prep girl was chewing gum and wearing a muscle shirt (not very hygienic). The check out person had no interest in helping a first time customer. I ordered two salads to go. You would think the bag would accommodate the bowl. It doesn't.  The bowls fit in side ways. Not impressed with the service.

Our food and service was excellent! Margaritas are delicious and the food is to die for! We had a Burrito La Catrina and Tres Amigos Fajitas. Fresh, flavorful and delicious! Can't wait to comeback and try other items on the menu! P.S. salsa for chips n salsa is perfect with a little kick!
This place is a local favorite from what I found out.  Very homestyle and the fried chicken was good.  Come with friends/family it is served family style.

As I sit her with my pants tight,  my heart is also as enlarged as my stomach. I just got done the Thanksgiving Feast from America's Pie and once again they crush any cuisine they offer. I never imagined doing take out for Thanksgiving. We've always done parents or in-laws but as we know this year is different. Truthfully it snuck up on me and I messaged them the night before pickup (Thanksgiving Eve) and was lucky to sneak in the last remaining spots.  The menu had a hefty amount of choices & servings in each category and the portions were enough for leftovers. 
Salad(1/2), Entrees(1/4), Sides(3/8). 
The entree category not only contained a large portion of delish and moist protein, it included gravy, dinner roll & cranberry. Considering that each meal contained 3-8 oz sides some of my family bartered for 1/2 side swaps. I was able to taste 5 of the 8 side choices by sharing and they were peppered with traditional tastiness beyond anything I could have whipped up during the craziness of a pandemic. One last perk was complete customization of each individual meal, no fighting over choosing the menu! At $25/pp it was a steal, I could have not provided that much varied food for the price let alone the time, effort and headache of shopping and cooking. There was even an option to buy extra sides($3) and 2 different desert options for purchase($5). We didn't get extra sides bc with 6 people we were able to cover all the side choices  but you know we hit up both bread pudding opti

Ordered 2 burgers and 2 fries at 7pm. The red headed girl with tattoos who works the orders gave me the wrong order and gave mine to another person. She said sorry. So after 20 minutes they gave me "correct order" but again it was wrong because it was missing the second set of fries. She said sorry. So now it's 7:30pm and she's getting me fries. I asked nicely if we could get something for the inconvenience, and she said she could ask. Came back and said she could offer a coupon? I told her ok that's fine we are not even from here since the one in Jacksonville closed it is not going to work. She said "no worries, give it to another customer" Sad, because the food is good but the service we received was terrible. No wonder I don't see many locations anymore

I rarely post comments.. but we had breakfast here and the kids were acting up.. there was a server named German and Ernest that came out of nowhere and did magic tricks for the kids.. totally spontaneously, out of their way, totally awesome.. it's people like them who make the difference..  thank you Bacara..

I gave 2 stars, but will change it once I come back and the experience is better.  It is to be expected when a restaurant chain is first opened.  The wait was long, a little over an hour.  When I went to the bar to get my husband a drink (he is impatient), the bartender wouldn't even look at me.  After about 10 minutes of waiting, I called out to a bar back and she was able to pour us a beer while we waited.  When we were finally sat, we were greeted with an amazing waitress (a former student of mine - she was great)  The food took forever because the kitchen was backed up and our shrimp came out ice cold along with the steak which was hot.  It took a total of 3 hours from the time we came into the restaurant to the time we left.  We will come back and give it another try, but if we had to chose, we will go to the Brandon location or next store to Texas Roadhouse - which I am not a huge fan of their steaks.
Friendly service. Excellent shrimp po boys. Good atmosphere. Fair prices. Highly recommended if you're looking for a po boy.
This is a pretty good place. It's been consistently good. Service is usually fine too. Glad to have a mexican restaurant that's a little more hole in the wall than some of the chains around town.

As the name suggests, their biryani and kebabs are excellent. I'd also like to add that their Indo Chinese selection is great too (noodles and dry chilly chicken, specifically).  I would highly recommend going there, though be warned that the lunch buffet isn't as good as their ala-cart
We are really glad this bbq spot opened back up.   It's a fast, yummy, easy family sized meal.  Spicy bbq sauce is excellent.  The service was great tonight!
Perhaps the most unique burger menu in St. Louis! Prepared fresh and always tasty. I love the En Fuego Burger and their fries are amazing.

Amazing!! It is serious the best Thai food we have found since we visited Thailand.  Love this place. It is worth making a reservation since they do fill up fast because of limited seating due to COVID

I'm visiting St Louis on a business trip, and stumbled upon The Bellwether on a list of restaurants in the area offering outdoor dining. What an excellent discovery! I went on a Monday night, when they were quiet with only a few parties other than myself. The bartender Brittany was super friendly and recommended some cocktails--'The Heart of the Matter' is especially tasty--and gave me plenty of space to enjoy my drink and peruse the food menu at my leisure. I opted for the ribeye, which was absolutely delicious. Perfectly cooked, beautifully presented, and generously portioned, it ticked all the boxes I'm looking for in a fantastic steak dinner. The bread pudding I had afterwards was just unreal. Maybe one of the top 10 desserts I've had, and I say that as someone with a major sweet tooth. All around a fantastic meal in a beautiful space--I ended up sitting indoors, but the patio looks lovely as well and had some nice views at sunset. I hope to make it back again before my trip ends!

What a treat! Really a welcome new offering in the otherwise bland restaurant landscape in theBroad Ripple area. Come with someone who is a little familiar with the process. It is a participatory activity and usually you pay per person to use the table for 2 hours. You can get refills of your soup ingredients for the entire 2 hour period. Your table has personal hot plate that will boil your soup broth choice where you add the vegetables, meats, noodles and spices. You can use other ingredients ordered by another on your table( if they want) - the soups were awesome and delicious! It's a fun activity!

Amazing food! Really delicious! Can't believe it is attached to a gas station. Only a few blocks from my home. Definitely an economical and satisfying choice for some semi-fast food grub! I got the lamb and chicken combo. Both are spiced well and the hummus that came with it was gone too fast. Quite impressed!
Just tried some of their sandwiches for the first time! Very good! So convenient! Great attitudes and excellent service!

So happy that this Raley's is my neighborhood store! They have a beautiful produce section and their meat and seafood section always has some wonderful selections. They also have a great selection of wines and beer and you can get growlers there!

I've eaten at the habit many times and enjoy the food.  Today I tried the tuna sandwich and it was amazing!  Vanessa who took my order suggested trying it on sourdough and oh my it was amazing!!!  I think this is my new favorite at the habit!  Based on the reviews I was a little sketchy about the wait but my food was ready in less than 10 min which is great considering they are not "fast food".  I'm always willing to wait for fresh food made food!  We will definitely be back.  Sorry I woulda took a pic but I already ate my food.

My bf and I did a day trip to SB and stumbled upon this place.  So glad we decided to give it a shot. We were very skeptical but ended up being pleasantly surprised! The food was so flavorful and delicious! We definitely recommend trying the enchiladas!

Oh my god, this place is incredible. Great Latin cuisine. Don't expect taqueria prices, but the food is incredible and the ingredients fresh. Don't have much else to say besides check out the pictures of the food. Ordered the chicken with the ham and cheese, guacamole, and cilantro. The empanadas are great too.

We seated ourselves in the bar area when we we were told there was a 20 minute wait for the restaurant area--note that there were at least 75% of the tables open. This was the first red flag. We sit for exactly 22 minutes before anybody comes over to say anything to us. I get that it's the bar area and things are not as "spot on" but 22 minutes seems insane. Please consider that during this time, we saw several (4-5 individuals) talking and joking around behind the bar. No sense of urgency whatsoever. Once the bartender came over to take our drinks, the excuses started flowing about how she was the only one working. Okay, fine, but I just saw multiple staff members standing around. We all order waters and decide to go ahead and order food as well, as we had a movie that we needed to get to and wanted to make sure that we would have plenty of time to eat. Three people at the table, split the check with two on one and one on another. Pretty simple--This is important for later. We sit for another 15-20 minutes. Mind you, we still have not received our waters. We didn't order any fancy drinks, so this seems insane to me. We were about to get up and leave when the waters show. No apologies for a 20 minute wait on water. While we are waiting for our food, we hear some patrons behind us complaining that their order was wrong and that they, too, had awful service. Shocking. The food arrived and most of the table was content with it, even though we had to flag down the waiter who brou

Not that I need to really need to do an elaborate review on Dominos, I mean if you dont know by not then you were born on another planet.

So I'll just say this location was cool. I ordered my pizza it came fast and it was good.

Was craving ramen and when a friend asked me to lunch I was quick to suggest this place. I missed the memo that they had changed their name from Uchi to Ramen 4 Real so not sure how long ago that happened. They also no longer offer take out which sucks a little bit isn't a huge deal.

Anyway, met my friend here and despite the name change and a few changes on the menu everything else seemed the same. The food was amazing as usual. I ordered the miso based ramen with an extra egg. I actually felt like the broth was more rich and flavorful compared to previous visits, which is why I've increased my rating another star. It was so so yummy. Gaaahhh just writing about it makes me want to go back right now.

My friend ordered pork buns to share, and even though they took a little longer to make their way to the table (we were fair warned by the waiter), they were worth the wait. Holy moly they were delicious. I wasn't a huge fan of the mayo on them... or maybe the amount of mayo but they were still delicious! 

All in all this place still has my vote. The ramen is fantastic. The service is quick and friendly. And and the prices are fair.

We visit Down the Hatch every year we travel to New Orleans. This visit alone we ate here 3 times! We love the alligator sausage po boy's! Its something about the bread and delicious sausage! We stumbled upon happy hour and the drinks were really great for 2 bucks! We will be back next year . Great food and service for 3 years 4 trips to the big easy!

Omg I love this place!! 
Amazing atmosphere and a great server (Tristan)! 
I highly recommend some mushrooms and onions on your juicy stake.

Absolutely stellar burgers. I have driven past this place a billion times and never knew it was there until a few months ago, and we've now eaten in or taken out four times. Every time the burgers have been awesome. Highly, highly recommend; one of the best burgers in STL.

After a friend recommended FWJ I had to try it. I'm so glad I did. 

Another friend and I shared the Croque Monsieur, Country Crepe and Nutella Crepe. Everything was delicious. 

The pastry case was very hard to pass up on this visit. So many delicious looking creations.  Next time for sure!

I have been meaning to try this place out for months, but somehow never made it in. My sister ended up sending me their Instagram page suggesting I try this place out because she knew my boyfriend is Dominican. He has been telling me that one of the dishes he missed eating was mangu and the moment he found out that it was on the menu he was so excited to try this place out. The restaurant itself is warm and inviting both inside and outside. He order the mangu and I ordered a plate with the beef ribs. We both loved our food and they served generous portions. We also both ordered the fresh juices. I had the mango with tasted so amazing. I would highly recommend Merengue and I'm excited to visit them again.

I loved the gumbo. My friend got a hamburger that was HUGE. The beans and rice were pretty decent, too. The smoked sausage with beans and rice was DELICIOUS. I actually can't get over how good the sausage was. The flavor was amazing!!! Apparently the gumbo they make here is gluten free...I was told by a friend. We picked Liuzza's because of the gluten free options.
Great Chinese spot. Its not about decor. It's a hole-in-the-wall type of place. However, their food taste fresh and delicious and their prices are pretty low. Really enjoy this place.
First time coming and will definitely come again! We had the burrito, flautas, sopa, and churros. All of the above were fantastic.

I came to this restaurant on a whim while in Santa Barbara because a restaurant at the Wharf had a 2 hour wait (I completely understand because of COVID). We parked directly down the street from the restaurant and found free street parking. Upon arrival we were quickly seated in their parking lot patio. Servers wore masks and everyone was distanced. We were also immediately greeted with water (love that because it's been so hot and humid lately) our server was kind and food was being run quickly to turn tables (so if you're hungry come here) 

We got calamari, poke, and their seafood pasta. All the servings were pretty large so we shared everything between myself and 2 other friends. I thought the sauce for the pasta was a bit heavy but still really good. Their sangria was not very good so I wouldn't recommend. I'll be back if I visit Santa Barbara again.

This place is the BEST! We were looking for a Christmas eve dinner and found good reviews on here! We got one special pizza and one with peppers sausage and pepperoni! We called and were told they were closing a bit early and to be in by 7! We were a few minutes late but they were SO friendly! Such a great attitude! I know being a few minutes late on Christmas Eve must have been frustrating but they didn't show it at all! The pizza was thin, delicious and cheesy!! I can't wait to go again! Not only is the pizza THE best but so is the service!!!

I had breakfast here on Sunday. It was my 2nd visit and it was just as good as my first one.

Corn Beef Hash with over medium eggs and sourdough toast: DELICIOUS. Best tasting corn beef hash I've had in all of Tennessee. Taste fresh with no weird after taste. Eggs are cook perfectly and the toast is great. 

Chicken and Waffles: The chicken has a slight spice to it. My son loved it. I thought it was good, but not something I'd order. The waffle was perfectly cooked.

Service: Very friendly and attentive. Our cups were kept foil and we were checked in on regularly.

This place has been packed full both times I visited. Getting seated usually seems like a mess, but it's definitely worth it once you sit down and eat!

We're here on a mini vacation and my husband wanted to eat somewhere that we didn't have locally. We were driving toward Olive Garden and passed by Lucky Dill. The name was neat and we weren't sure what it was, but we knew that we did not have one at home so--Lucky Dill was our new destination. 

It's a restaurant that focuses on deli style sandwiches, burgers, with interesting names with New York flavor. The menus was extensive and we had a hard time choosing what to have and I honestly don't remember the names of most of what we chose except "hangover sliders" which were quite tasty except they ran out of eggs. 

The food portions are ENORMOUS, absolutely nobody in my family finished their meal. (Thank goodness our hotel room has a kitchen!) the kid's meals are certainly kid friendly but the chicken tenders are (1) huge and (2) breaded differently and use real chicken breast meat. I personally loved it but of course, kids don't always agree. My other son ordered a grilled cheese and it was like 3 sandwiches stacked on one another, they each shared a half a sandwich and proclaimed themselves full. I had a chicken --something that reminded me of a Hawaiian pizza. It was fine but I didn't love it. 

The one part I didn't love was the slow service. Definitely not NY style with that!

There is also a bakery on premises but it is extremely expensive. We each ordered one *small* pastry and our total was $17!! It was good but not that good. 

I'm glad we tried something new but if

The Sacchetti is one of the best things I have ever eaten. The service was nice. We were not in a hurry so I can't say how quick it was. Hostess seemed a little frazzled- but friendly/- perhaps she was new? A manager was helping her too.  We sat outside on the couches due to it being every busy. Had a couple ask to join us who were also friendly. 
Boyfriend had a flatbread which was also good.  (I can't remember which as it's been a month or so ago when we visited) 
I can't wait to visit again as I dream about this damn pasta!
Prime Rib French Dip! Nothing more need be said.

Great Tacos here!  We are from out of town visiting and stopped here for a late dinner , about 8:30 pm. Place was very clean and staff very friendly. We had the shrimp Tacos and cooked with great seasonings. 
We will be back!

This place was fantastic! Not only was the food some of the best Italian I've ever had, but the staff was so friendly and helpful. I had a party of 14 that they stayed open late for to accommodate my time frame, and Jeri our server was the one who arranged everything to make it extra special for our birthday boy!! Great place. I'll be back many times!
We love Johnny Bronx SO MUCH!! Best pizza in the Valley! Meatball subs are so good you might cry. Love JB!!

Very clean! Customer service is awesome  and best of all the food is delicious . Large servings given when we went for breakfast. So happy there is good Latin food near our area!!!  Will be back for more!!!
Mediocre food, bland gluten-free pizzas, we went there once and may not come back, we've gone to worse but this place could be so much better.
Fantastic, cheap and quick and delicious. The staff is friendly, quick, and considerate. A staple for workday lunch.

I came in with my wife the other day for drinks and apps. Once we paid, we noticed we were charged $3.23 more than what the itemized receipt said, it was $17. We asked the bartender and a she says she doesn't know why it did that and walked away. I had to walk down the  bar and ask for her manager. She pointed at a man sitting at the  bar. After I went over to talk to him. He says it's the owners decision to add a 3% to the bill because the city raised the taxes and that it was posted on the door, which It was not. 3% of $17 is not $3.23 extra, it's alittle over 50 cents. Your logic does not make sense. While talking with him he just shrugged his shoulders and turned around, back to sitting at bar. As someone who worked 16 years in the restaurant industry, working every position including management. I will never come back to this poorly ran restaurant.
The food was good, but not very hot, barely warm. delivery was originally 30-40 mins and was extended to longer halfway through. Had the food been hotter it would have been perfect.

The good: Fabulous decorated sugar cookies!  I bought some for my husband & son for Valentines Day and they were demolished quickly.  Lol We also really enjoyed the Breakfast Bread.  The loaf was just the right amount of sweet and awesomely moist.  Yum!
The bad:  I just had a croissant breakfast sandwich to go.  The sandwich was packed/smashed so much that it resembled a flattened grilled cheese.  This being a bakery, I was hoping to enjoy the croissant.  Good flavor overall though.  
With the Breakfast Loaf being so good I decided to get a Banana Bread loaf this time.  It was so dry that it was ridiculously crumbly.  I almost tried to make it better with butter to be able to eat it but knew it would just crumble apart when trying to spread it.  Disappointed.

I hadn't been to Sweet Tomatoes in a while, but when the temperatures dipped down in the 30s and 40s, all I could think of was soup! - and they're always a good place for soup. 

One thing I love about Sweet Tomatoes is the array of healthy options, and the ability to get what you want on your salad. I remember a time when many restaurants had a salad bar. Now, as far as I can tell, this and Ruby Tuesday's are all that remain. Instead, most restaurants sell their own prepared salads for at least $8 - and I'm usually picking stuff off. At Sweet Tomatoes, for just a couple dollars more, you can have all the salad you want, and prepared the way YOU want it. 

Included in this price, you also get a variety of soups, plus pastas, desserts, muffins, etc. (My only complaint is that a drink should be included in the price.)

The food is hit and miss here. There is always something really good, while something else is off. On my most recent visit, for instance, the salad bar was great. All fresh ingredients. But the pre-prepared Caesar salad  was soggy (the croutons in it). Also the vegetable soup was bland, with very little flavor. The broccoli-cheddar soup that my daughter got, however, was delicious. 

Sweet Tomatoes is also good for children, as they have child-friendly options such as macaroni and cheese, pizza, and an ice cream machine. 

Another positive is that they have many gluten free and vegetarian options.
Quirky, relaxing atmosphere. Sitting outside makes it feel like you're having brunch in a rainforest. Delicious food and fun photo ops. One of our favorites!

I am a previous patron of the former excellent thai restaurant that was at this location.  I loved the food at Mayouie (spelling wrong of course). I think they had a following for excellent food that was  served with a twist. ;-)
      I was really hoping that this new restaurant would live up to the hype and be comparable. First of all the servers were excellent! Super friendly and warmly welcoming.  We brought wine and samples a few delicious dishes. Everything tasted super fresh and delicious. Everyone was raving about the vegetarian Nom Khao salad that I had to taste it for my self. Let's just say I might go back and have it for lunch today! Such a delicious assortment of crunchy ribbons of vegetables with crispy and soft rice. I picked mine up  in the lettuce leaf and ate it like a wrap. It was phenomenal. We shared the appetizer sampler's which was  pretty standard. One simple observation was that I felt that the spring roll might have been store-bought, but it was still pretty stander and tasty. The Chicken wings were the winner on this plate.  I really enjoyed my pad Thai though. My husband ordered  drunken noodles that came out very mild but when he mentioned it, they swept away the dish and quickly tossed them in the wok with more spice. He was very pleased with the end result. The noodles were absolutely delicious.  I didn't try the coconut soup which is leaving me feeling like a missed out. The table next to us we're really enjoying theres.  The crispy duck that k

Very wired Menu and could not understand the Waiter at all. So we ended up just ordering something that we had no Idea of what it was. 
It seems like it would be better served for Insiders.

Food was great. I got the Fried chicken and it was an enormous serving. The Gnocchi and Truffle Fries were also amazing. The restaurant is a little pricy but definitely worth it. The atmosphere alone is awesome.

Toasted ravioli is AMAZING. The chicken Parmesan was great, too. I have no complaints about Anthonino's at all and will definitely make it a point to go back if I'm in the area. They also have great bread and the alcohol options are top notch.

I have been living in Tampa for 4 years  now and have finally found my go to sushi spot. After years of trial and error with many subpar spots around, I found oishi on Yelp and decided to give it a try. We ordered delivery with Uber eats and everything came in perfectly packaged and so quickly as well. We got 3 special rolls which all were cooked..  the monster, Larry, and Tokyo tower. We couldn't decided which was our favorite because they were all delicious. Highly recommend.

So this restaurant is ALRIGHT. Not the worst but definitely not the best either. The broth was so so, i little bit on the fatty tasting side. We were the only people in the restaurant and our server even forgot our order. And to think we only ordered 2 servings of the Special beef pho. 
We will probably comeback if we have some latenight pho cravings since they close late (2am)..but other than that, we'll just wait for our fav Vietnamese restaurant to open again.. definitely not our first choice.

We love Angelino's! This is a reliable, friendly, neighborhood establishment. My boyfriend and I order takeout from here multiple times a month, and we're never disappointed. There's been a noticeable uptick in business since the Barstool review, but the owners are doing their best to keep up with demand and quality (in a pandemic, no less). They aren't a fast food joint, so don't be disappointed if they sell out of pizza - that's how we discovered some other favorites.

We recommend the vodka pizza, chicken parm sandwich, bacon avocado burger, and gnocchi.

Tasty shrimp delicious king crab legs scrumptious crawfish I'll serve you in a bag of butter. Highly recommended, and the food always seems to be ready to pick up in about five minutes. This place is great

I can find the option for 0 stars. Just paid 30 dollars for this slop. Ordered for pick up, went home opened my order to find a spongy donut breaded chicken, literally look like deep fried chicken but with the consistancy of a soggy donut. I ordered crabragoon a well, they said it wasn't sweet, I take a bite and it could pass as a dessert. Now I'm just mad and hungry.

They add a 10% operation fee on your check without telling you. When we asked what it was for our server responded by saying that it helps keep them open. I'm sorry, but am I not doing that by coming in, sitting down and ordering $170 worth of food and drinks in an hour span? So with 10% operation fee. 20% tip plus our taxes on a $170 check was quite hefty.  I will not be returning because I felt like I got ripped off completely. AT LEAST state it on your menu. Buffalo wings are good tho.
Worst quesadilla I've ever seen and definitely not worth  $7. Figured you couldn't mess up one of the easiest things on the menu but I was wrong.

This is my second time eating here and I not overly impressed.  The Satays where probably my favourite (meat on stick) with peanut sauce was very good.  However the other plates where not my favourite.  My wife enjoyed it a lot so maybe just me.
Loved this place. Try the French onion soup it is homemade and amazing!!! Low key atmosphere lots of beers to try.
